knowledge_gaps: The gate is an additive residual, not a convex blend. A bias of -2 does not guarantee baseline-equivalent initialization because the projection and final LayerNorm also affect predictions. Pooling, padding masks, projection initialization, and normalization parameters need explicit definitions.

Negative sampling is underspecified: shared versus independent candidates, duplicate handling, rejection sampling versus masking, and positions with no valid negatives produce different objectives. Uniform sampling alone does not establish equivalence to full-catalog cross-entropy after user-dependent exclusions.

The experiment lacks baseline validation HR@10, checkpoint-selection rules, optimizer settings, and a GPU-time allocation. A baseline/objective-only/fusion-only/combined comparison is needed to attribute gains; repeated selection on 200 users per category also risks validation overfitting.

The proposed branch measures recency in interaction count, not elapsed time, and averages away order within its window. It may amplify recent isolated interactions or popularity rather than recover specific intent. Simulator comments and training-pair margins do not establish that this mechanism addresses the observed failures.

Originality 4/10 is plausible for an established-component combination. Potential 8/10 and difficulty 4/10 remain subjective without benchmark results and a resource estimate. The report also omits an explicit procedure for the required twenty-user full-catalog simulator recommendations.
